name: synapse-agentic-architectural-patterns
purpose: Reusable local-first patterns for building governed enterprise multi-agent systems.
source_note: Inspired by public agentic architecture practices and enterprise multi-agent system design. This file defines Synapse-specific contracts and does not copy book content.

patterns.name: Orchestrator Specialist
patterns.intent: Use one lead orchestrator to route work to the smallest useful specialist set.
use_when: multiple domains are required
a fleet lead must synthesize specialist advice
task complexity exceeds a single agent
guardrails: do not simulate separate model calls unless they happened
do not activate all 60 agents by default
record selected agents and decision fingerprint

patterns.name: Critic Reviewer Gate
patterns.intent: Route risky outputs through review roles and quality gates before release.
use_when: security or compliance risk is present
production release decision is requested
local model output fails validation
guardrails: human approval is required for high-risk irreversible actions
review findings must be linked to evidence
failed quality checks must not be hidden by fallback

patterns.name: Agent To Agent Message Contract
patterns.intent: Exchange short structured messages between Codex, Claude, AdoneX, Ruflo and humans.
use_when: another assistant already has useful context
token cost can be reduced by sharing summaries
handoff requires traceability
guardrails: no secrets in peer messages
send summaries before asking for full context
keep messages local unless cloud is explicitly approved

patterns.name: Tool Gateway
patterns.intent: Keep tool access behind explicit permissions, scopes and audit records.
use_when: tools can read files, run commands or affect external systems
agents need different permissions
actions need rollback or human approval
guardrails: least privilege by default
external side effects require approval
tool calls must be logged with project, agent and request id

patterns.name: Model Router
patterns.intent: Route requests by task type, cost, sensitivity and quality instead of letting agents call models directly.
use_when: multiple local or cloud models exist
cost and latency must be controlled
fallback and cache behavior must be auditable
guardrails: local-first routing
cloud opt-in only
deterministic local cache for temperature zero
large models selected only by strong signal or explicit profile

patterns.name: Shared Memory Retrieval
patterns.intent: Retrieve concise prior context before asking a model to reason from scratch.
use_when: project memory may contain relevant lessons
RAG or semantic search can reduce prompt size
similar tasks were already completed
guardrails: approved memory before weight updates
retrieve summaries before raw artifacts
cite or identify memory source when it affects decisions

patterns.name: Lifecycle Callbacks
patterns.intent: Expose stable execution events for observability, governance and debugging.
use_when: an agent plan is created
a model route is selected
tools or memory are used
quality or approval gates decide execution
guardrails: callbacks are audit events, not extra model calls
callbacks must not include secrets
callback payloads must use ids and summaries
